title: Beyond Immerse Plant Protein Energy Drink With Caffeine
summary: Looking for a protein energy drink? Beyond Immerse Protein + Energy is a sparkling plant protein drink with caffeine, fiber and electrolytes. Learn more.
body_markdown:
*Company also adds three new flavors to Beyond Immerse lineup, expanding the range to six flavors*


EL SEGUNDO, Calif., October 15, 2026 — Beyond Meat, Inc. (NASDAQ: BYND), also known as Beyond the Plant Protein Company™, today announced its entry into the energy category with Beyond Immerse Protein + Energy, a sparkling protein drink that brings together plant protein, fiber, antioxidants, electrolytes, and caffeine from coffee beans and guarana extract. Available in Cherry Berry and Watermelon Strawberry, Beyond Immerse Protein + Energy is launching exclusively at[www.BeyondPlantProtein.com](https://www.beyondplantprotein.com/) .


The company is also adding three new flavors to its Beyond Immerse lineup: Watermelon Strawberry, available now, and Limoncello Ginger and Yuzu Grapefruit, coming soon. The new flavors join Peach Mango, Strawberry Lemonade, and Cherry Berry, expanding the Beyond Immerse range to six flavors. Together, the beverages bring the superpowers of plants to more moments in the day: Beyond Immerse for when consumers want plant protein, fiber, antioxidants, and electrolytes in one refreshing can, and Beyond Immerse Protein + Energy for that same nutrition with caffeine.


“We believe plants have superpowers, and few are as widely appreciated by consumers as caffeine,” said Ethan Brown, Founder and CEO of Beyond Meat. “As we add energy to the Beyond Immerse portfolio, we are staying true to our approach: great taste and carefully selected, limited ingredients that help consumers thrive.”


**Beyond Immerse and Beyond Immerse Protein + Energy feature:**


- Excellent source of protein with 20g per serving, critical to support muscle health
- Good source of fiber with 5g per serving, vital to support a healthy gut
- Excellent source of antioxidant Vitamin A from Beta-Carotene, essential to support immune function
- Made with electrolytes
- No GMOs
- No dairy


Beyond Immerse Protein + Energy also delivers 160mg of caffeine per serving.


The expansion follows the retail introduction of Beyond Immerse in the New York metropolitan area through[Big Geyser](https://www.beyondmeat.com/en-US/press/beyond-meat-launches-beyond-immerse-in-new-york) and its recent launch at[Erewhon](https://www.beyondmeat.com/en-US/press/beyond-immerse-now-available-at-erewhon) locations across Southern California.


For more information, visit[www.BeyondPlantProtein.com](https://www.beyondplantprotein.com/) . **** ****


**About Beyond Meat**


Beyond Meat, Inc. (NASDAQ: BYND), otherwise known as Beyond The Plant Protein Company™, is a plant protein company offering a portfolio of plant-based products made with non-GMO ingredients, no added hormones or antibiotics, and 0mg of cholesterol per serving. Founded in 2009, Beyond Meat’s core products are designed to have the same taste and texture as animal-based meat while being better for people and the planet. The company’s brand promise, Eat What You Love®, represents a strong belief that there is a better way to feed our future and that the positive choices we all make, no matter how small, can have a great impact on our personal health and the health of our planet. By shifting from animal-based protein to plant-based protein, we can positively impact four growing global issues: human health, climate change, constraints on natural resources and animal welfare. Visit[www.BeyondMeat.com](https://www.beyondmeat.com/) and follow @BeyondMeat on Facebook, Instagram, Threads and LinkedIn.
